rules.statement: A teacher's salary, earned by a person governed by the Thesawalamai, is not considered tediatetam property under section 21 of the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance No. 1 of 1911.
rules.supporting_quote: "The salary earned as a teacher by a person, who is governed by the Thesawalamai, is not tediatetam property within the meaning of section 21 of the Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance."
